claim: Uber Boat by Thames Clippers reaches Greenwich Pier in roughly 20 min from Tower, 25 min from London Bridge, and 40-45 min from Westminster/London Eye, with Oyster/contactless accepted.
quote: Westminster to Greenwich: around 45 minutes... Tower Bridge to Greenwich: 20 minutes... contactless and Oyster cards to pay for Uber Boat tickets on the day

claim: Cutty Sark in Greenwich charges £22 adult / £11 child in 2026, open daily 10am-5pm (until 6pm in summer) with audio guide included.
quote: Adult: £22... Child: £11... 10am-5pm (last entry 4.15pm)... Summer Season (June 27 - August 31, 2026): 10am-6pm

claim: Cutty Sark DLR station is closed until at least spring 2026, so visitors should alight at Greenwich mainline station or use Island Gardens + the foot tunnel.
quote: Cutty Sark DLR station is currently closed until at least spring 2026, so disembark either at Island Gardens and take the Greenwich Foot Tunnel beneath the Thames or get off at Greenwich Station

claim: Kew Gardens 2026 peak-season (Feb-Oct) tickets are £25 online / £28 at the gate for adults; off-peak (Nov-Jan) drops to £17 online.
quote: Online: £25 (£27.50 with donation)... Gate: £28 (£31 with donation)... Off-Peak Season (1 November – 31 January) Adult prices drop to £17 online and £20 at the gate

claim: Kew Gardens is roughly 30 minutes from central London via District Line to Kew Gardens station, a 10-minute walk from the entrance.
quote: the District Line's Kew Gardens station is just a ten-minute walk through a lovely neighborhood from the garden gate... Kew is just 30 minutes from central London

claim: Hampton Court Palace is a 35-minute South Western Railway ride from Waterloo (every 30 min), with the station a five-minute walk from the palace.
quote: National Rail train services run from London Waterloo every 30 minutes, and the journey takes approximately 35 minutes. Hampton Court train station is located a five-minute walk from the palace

claim: Hampton Court Palace adult admission starts at £27.20 in 2026, covering the Tudor palace, gardens, and the famous maze.
Windsor Castle is reachable by GWR from Paddington (~30 min via a Slough change) to Windsor & Eton Central, or direct from Waterloo (~1h-1h15) to Windsor & Eton Riverside.
quote: The train runs from Paddington Station in London, makes a transfer at Slough, and then runs to Windsor with a travel time of about 30 minutes... about one hour to one hour and fifteen minutes to travel from Waterloo station to Windsor

claim: Windsor Castle 2026 adult tickets are £32 booked in advance via Royal Collection Trust, or £36 on the day, with under-5s free.
quote: In 2026, tickets for Windsor Castle cost £32 for adults if booked in advance. If you buy your tickets on the day you will pay £36 for adults

claim: Richmond Park is free, open 24/7 to pedestrians, spans 5,000 acres with ~600 red and fallow deer, plus King Henry's Mound for a protected view of St Paul's.
quote: The park hosts approximately 600 red and fallow deer that have inhabited the area since 1637... King Henry's Mound – Offers distant views toward St Paul's Cathedral... Pedestrian gates are open 24/7

claim: Visitors should keep at least 50m from deer in Richmond Park, particularly during May-July calving and autumn rut.
quote: Try and stay at least 50 metres away, though, especially during May-July when mama is fiercely protecting their babies, and in the autumn when the male deer get especially lairy

claim: Highgate Cemetery East side (Karl Marx's grave) costs £10 adult self-guided; a West ticket at £10 also includes East entry for the Victorian Gothic catacombs.
quote: Adult £10, Children 8-17 £5, Students* £8 for the East Cemetery self-guided visit... West Highgate ticket prices are £10 per adult and £6 per child for a self-guided tour

claim: Warner Bros Studio Tour London (Making of Harry Potter) adult tickets start at £58.50 and must be pre-booked; reach via Euston to Watford Junction (20 min) then a £3 shuttle bus.
quote: Adult tickets start from £58.50... Train from London Euston to Watford Junction (20 min) then the purple studio shuttle (15 min, £3 return)

claim: London-Brighton fastest trains take ~58 min, with an off-peak return around £28; weekend evening trains 5-7pm are very crowded.
quote: The fastest train journey from London to Brighton takes around 58 minutes... An off-peak return is typically £28... Trains between 5pm and 7pm on weekends are packed — standing room only

claim: Oxford is ~44 min to 1h13 from London Paddington via GWR (also Marylebone), with advance fares from about £5.40 one-way.
quote: The journey from London to Oxford by train takes around 1 hour and 13 minutes... The fastest journey is 44 minutes... Advance fares between London and Oxford can start from £5.40 one-way

claim: Coach tours combine Stonehenge and Bath in roughly 11 hours from London, with packages from £99 (excluding Roman Baths) to £135 including Roman Baths.
quote: These tours typically last approximately 11 hours... Complete tour packages (excluding Roman Baths) start from £99.00, with tours including Roman Baths from £135.00
